Resolves #19178

A click on a drag target that ends before the delay + distance threshold now leaves the Mouse and Touch sensors idle: `endGesture` / `onTouchEnd` reset the pressed element, the start event, the press point and the press time on every release, not only after a drag. `Neo.main.addon.EventSimulator#driveDrag` reads the pressed element and the drag flag to refuse a busy sensor, so every drive consumer — the Neural Link's `drive_drag`, the Workstation film's cues — no longer answers `MOUSE_SENSOR_BUSY` after an ordinary click in the window.

Evidence: L3 achieved (the Workstation film replay on PR #19182's branch, which carries this fix: the rail beat's tab click then the resize drive — `MOUSE_SENSOR_BUSY` at 15:23Z without it, 3/3 green at `7d76288412` with it, 1/1 headed at `b95f7ba8b5` after the dev merge) → L3 required (AC-3). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — a state reset moved out of a branch in two sibling sensors, with the arms that pin it; no contract surface changes.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/main/draggable/sensor/Mouse.spec.mjs` — "a release before the threshold leaves no pressed element behind" (element, start event, press time and press point all idle) and the extended "pre-threshold lost release" arm; the terminal-contract arms unchanged and green |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/main/draggable/sensor/Touch.spec.mjs` (new) — a tap leaves no pressed element, no start event, no press point and no press time; a drag still ends with exactly one `drag:end` |
| AC-3 | CI-covered half: the Mouse arm asserts the busy predicate's exact inputs (`currentElement || dragging`) read false after the click; L3 half: #19182's film replay runs the rail beat's clicks before the resize drive on a branch carrying this fix — refused as busy at 15:23Z on dev's sensors, 3/3 green at `7d76288412` and 1/1 headed at `b95f7ba8b5` with it |

## Deltas from ticket
- Both sensors also clear the press point (`pageX` / `pageY`) and the press time (`mouseDownTime` / `touchStartTime`) on release — the ticket's Fix said so, the first commit cleared them on the Mouse sensor only; Euclid's pre-submit read caught the Touch half, now cleared and asserted.
